job_dir.ask: Folder DIFFRAC.MEASUREMENT CENTER imports job files from
job_dir.help: The folder the lab's job template / DIFFRAC.COMMANDER script / LIMS import watches (see references/diffrac_files.md). Must exist and be writable by the account running mhp on the DIFFRAC PC.

results_dir.ask: Folder where the .brml raw files of the queued scans are written
results_dir.help: The result folder of the job template; the package waits for <sample_id>_<token>.brml there.

xy_dir.ask: Folder where the .xy text export is written (blank if it is the results folder or there is none)
xy_dir.help: DIFFRAC's Result Manager or a post-processing script can export each result as a two-column .xy text file; the package reads it when the .brml cannot be parsed.

methods_dir.ask: DIFFRAC.SUITE method folder holding the .bsml measurement methods

changer_positions.ask: Number of positions on the sample changer

changer_s.ask: Seconds a changer cycle takes (for progress and the wait)

max_points.ask: Most data points a queued scan may have

max_scan_hours.ask: Longest scan an agent may queue (hours)

poll_s.ask: Seconds between checks of the results folder

result_wait_s.ask: Longest wait for a result before the job fails (seconds)
